text:
elaine (docs): heads-up — just pushed PR to migrate KMS examples and redact the 'customer token' snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9245
elaine (docs): it touches sensitive.md and the quickstart snippets, so we need sec + legal signoff before merging.
mike (eng): saw the diff, nice cleanup. quick question: do we need to remove the exact key name from the sample env, or is redaction inline enough?
elaine (docs): prefer removing the key name and using <REDACTED_KEY> placeholder. security asked for no real-looking tokens.
jessica (security): +1 on placeholder. One extra ask: can you add a short note about KMS rotation best practices? makes compliance easier.
elaine (docs): yep — will add a two-sentence note under the example.
ci-bot: build started for commit 3f8a2b1 (docs PR 9245)
ci-bot: docs preview generation failed — Missing S3 creds for preview bucket (error 403)
mike (eng): hmm — preview failure is infra flakiness; not a blocker for approvals but we should avoid merging until preview accessible for reviewers.
elaine (docs): understood. tagging sec/legal for explicit approval in the thread, will wait for previews if possible.
omar (legal): quick read — redaction approach looks fine. Could you remove the customer email from the example too? it could be PII.
elaine (docs): will remove emails. Quick note — how urgent is this? there is a customer asking for the migration guide today.
jessica (security): we can expedite review. I'll sign off if the placeholder + rotation note added, and a short changelog entry referencing the customer's request.
ci-bot: build finished with errors (preview failed). Logs: `ERROR: s3 PutObject denied`
mike (eng): ops can grant temporary preview access. @elaine can open an infra ticket or ping #eng-infra — I can onboard the ticket.
elaine (docs): created ticket ENGINF-2113 and pinged @mike for follow-up.
omar (legal): once sec signs off, I can provide a legal approval comment in the PR. Please add a single sentence in the doc: "No production secrets are shown in examples."
elaine (docs): added that sentence and removed customer email + real-looking tokens. pushed new commit 7b9c6d2.
ci-bot: build started for commit 7b9c6d2 (docs PR 9245)
jessica (security): quick pass done — rotation note and placeholder look good. approving in PR. :white_check_mark:
omar (legal): approving in PR as well. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: build finished — docs preview available at https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/9245 (note: may be intermittent)
mike (eng): looks good in preview now.
elaine (docs): thanks all — merging after CI green and one more runtime check. I'll hold merge until 11:15 PT so the customer can see the preview and confirm.
mike (eng): SGTM, I'll watch the release window.
elaine (docs): merged at 1793001510 — follow-up: I'll post a short change note in #customer-success and update the migration checklist doc with the redaction pattern.
ci-bot: merged PR 9245 into main (commit 9a1f2c3)
